issue.title: Continuous testing: Support specifying unit, ITs, and QuarkusTests
issue.body:
## Description
The continuous testing feature suggests to activate the `dev`-mode testing based on different test scopes, currently *all*, *QuarkusTest*, or *unit*.

It would be helpful to make the distinction between *unit* test (how the Maven surefire plugin defines them, i.e. classes that end with `*Test`), *integration tests* (Maven failsafe integration tests, i.e. ending with `*IT`), and `QuarkusTest`.

Many projects make this distinction since Maven per default doesn't execute `IT`s, and thus projects include tests that, for example, require a running application. This would be very helpful to control in the `dev` mode -- at least by a configuration flag which tests should be auto-executed, or also by a control key.

This is somewhat connected to the bug in #17557.
